title: 第3章 这次任务是勾引一个女魔头第4章 先天未亡人圣体
slug: 大楚第一探花开局卧底女魔头
content_zh:
看到对方目瞪口呆的样子，宋牧驰微微一笑“元姑娘，我应该没有迟到吧？”
“没有……你是如何做到的？”
“不先请我进去喝一杯么？”
元红鸾心中好奇难耐，于是甜甜一笑“公子请上座！”
宋牧驰直接坐到了窗边，看了一眼桌上的空杯。
元红鸾不禁有些牙痒痒，她当然看出了对方的示意，不过确实好奇，便主动替他倒了一杯酒。
正在远处瞭望的鱼忠贤眼神一凝，素闻炽翎郡主火热张扬，什么时候见她这样小女儿姿态过。
难不成那小子说的是真的？
酒杯倒满过后宋牧驰却没有动，反而望向眼前娇媚的少女“能否劳烦郡主喂我喝？”
元红鸾眼中泛起一丝杀机“你想死么？”
尽管被犹如实质的杀机笼罩，宋牧驰却没有一点慌张“郡主是不是忘了我们的赌约？”
元红鸾瞬间气势一窒，输了就要帮他做一件事。
“堂堂的炽翎郡主不会要食言吧？”宋牧驰目光灼灼。
元红鸾咬了咬红唇，旋即有些不解“你好不容易赢了，就让我做这样简单的事？”
要知道她可是堂堂大乾国的炽翎郡主，长得极美，修为又高，若是其他人得到这样的允诺，不知道要让她帮忙做些什么呢！
宋牧驰微微一笑“能喝上郡主喂的酒，比其他任何事都重要。”
他需要取信鱼忠贤，不过落在元红鸾耳中，却被她想岔了，脸上红晕一闪而逝“将来可别后悔。”
她担心对方提出什么更难的事情，虽然她未必真要照做，但以她的骄傲终究不想当一个出尔反尔之人。
将那杯酒送到宋牧驰唇边，似笑非笑“你可别对我打什么主意，不然那冰坨子说不定真的要伤心了。”
两人靠得很近，甚至能清楚闻到她身上的甜香。

宋牧驰没有说话，就那样看着她，缓缓将她手中的酒喝尽。
元红鸾被他的眼神弄得心头一跳，她也不明白自己慌什么，明明随手一巴掌都能拍死这家伙。
这小子眼睛比星空还要深邃迷人……
这时宋牧驰忽然伸手一把将她抱入怀中，腰肢是那么的纤细柔-软。
元红鸾第一反应并不是生气，而是震惊，这小子怎么敢的！
房间中的温度瞬间升高，在她即将爆发的时候，宋牧驰快速说道“隐兰台的人准备围捕你！”
听到这里元红鸾反而有些释然，我就说嘛，果然有原因。
神念急忙朝周围笼罩而去，很快发现了好几个隐兰台的密探。
眼中闪过一丝杀机“你出卖我？”
宋牧驰叹了一口气“如果我出卖了你又何必提醒你？”
元红鸾并不傻，马上反应过来“多半是你拿我的消息跟隐兰台做交易，所以才从牢房里出来了。”
“我要出来又何必找隐兰台。”宋牧驰神色平静，借助墙壁挡住了远处鱼忠贤的目光，发动了异象·通勤。
整个人瞬移到隔壁，又缓缓走了回来。
看到这一幕，元红鸾一张红唇张得老大。
“对不起我误会你了。”元红鸾脸色微红，对方有这本事大牢又哪里拦得住。
昨天自己的表现落在对方眼中肯定像小丑一样，旋即把怒火转移到隐兰台众人之上“区区这几个人简直是来找死！”
“如果鱼忠贤亲自出马了呢？”宋牧驰一把拉住她的手。
元红鸾心中一惊，借着对方的遮挡，偷偷往远处望去，果然发现了远处的鱼忠贤。
content_en:
Seeing the stunned look on her face, Song Muchi smiled slightly, "Miss Yuan, I shouldn't be late, right?"
"No...how did you do it?"
"Why don't you invite me in for a drink first?"
Yuan Hongluan couldn't bear the curiosity, so she smiled sweetly and said, "Master, please take a seat!"
Song Muchi sat directly by the window and glanced at the empty glass on the table.
Yuan Hongluan couldn't help but feel a little itchy. Of course she saw the other party's signal, but she was really curious and took the initiative to pour him a glass of wine.
Yu Zhongxian, who was watching from a distance, had his eyes focused. He had always heard Princess Chi Ling being so fiery and public, but had never seen her act like a little daughter before.
Could it be that what that kid said was true?
After the wine glass was filled, Song Muchi did not move. Instead, he looked at the charming girl in front of him, "Can you please feed me, Princess?"
There was a trace of murderous intent in Yuan Hongluan's eyes: "Do you want to die?"
Even though he was enveloped by the real murderous intention, Song Muchi didn't panic at all, "Did the princess forget our bet?"
Yuan Hongluan was instantly suffocated. If he lost, he had to do something for him.
"The dignified Princess Chi Ling won't break her promise, will she?" Song Muchi's eyes were burning.
Yuan Hongluan bit her red lips and immediately became a little puzzled: "You finally won, so you let me do such a simple thing?"
You must know that she is the princess Chi Ling of the Dagan Kingdom. She is extremely beautiful and has high cultivation. If other people get such a promise, I don’t know what she will do to help!
Song Muchi smiled slightly, "Being able to drink the wine fed by the princess is more important than anything else."
He needed to win Yu Zhongxian's trust, but Yuan Hongluan fell in her ears, but she was distracted. The blush on his face flashed away: "Don't regret it in the future."
She was worried that the other party would ask for something more difficult. Although she might not really do it, with her pride she didn't want to be someone who went back on her word.
Putting the glass of wine to Song Muchi's lips, he smiled half-heartedly, "Don't make any plans for me, otherwise that Bingtuozi might really be sad."
The two of them were so close that they could even smell her sweet fragrance clearly.
Song Muchi said nothing, just looked at her and slowly drank the wine in her hand.
Yuan Hongluan's heart skipped a beat because of his eyes. She didn't understand why she was panicking. She could kill this guy with just a slap.
This boy's eyes are more profound and charming than the starry sky...
At this time, Song Muchi suddenly reached out and hugged her into his arms. Her waist was so slender and soft.
Yuan Hongluan's first reaction was not anger, but shock. How dare this kid!
The temperature in the room rose instantly. Just when she was about to explode, Song Muchi said quickly, "The people from Yinlan Terrace are preparing to round you up!"
Yuan Hongluan felt a little relieved when he heard this. Let me just say, there is indeed a reason.
Shen Nian hurriedly moved towards the surrounding area, and soon discovered several spies from Yinlan Terrace.
A hint of murderous intent flashed in his eyes, "Are you betraying me?"
Song Muchi sighed, "If I betrayed you, why would I need to remind you?"
Yuan Hongluan was not stupid, and immediately realized, "It's probably because you used my information to make a deal with Yinlantai, and that's why you got out of the cell."
"Why should I look for Yinlan Terrace if I want to come out?" Song Muchi looked calm, using the wall to block Yu Zhongxian's gaze in the distance, and activated Vision Commuting.
The whole person teleported to the next door, and then slowly walked back.
Seeing this scene, Yuan Hongluan opened her red lips.
"I'm sorry I misunderstood you." Yuan Hongluan's face turned slightly red. If the other party had such ability, how could the prison stop him.
Yesterday, my performance must have been like a clown in the eyes of the other party. He immediately transferred his anger to everyone in Yinlan Terrace, "These few people are just looking for death!"
"What if Yu Zhongxian takes action himself?" Song Muchi took her hand.
Yuan Hongluan was startled, and took advantage of the opponent's cover to secretly look into the distance, and sure enough, he spotted Yu Zhongxian in the distance.
